```{r echo=FALSE}
dat <- read.csv("../data/behavioural_eeg_data.csv")

phys_cont <- read.csv("../data/SpO2_continuous.csv")

phys_int <- read.csv("../data/SpO2_intermittent.csv")
```

CONTINUOUS SPO2
```{r echo=FALSE}
library(ARTool)
phys_cont$Session <- factor(
  phys_cont$Session,
  levels = c("0", "1")
)

phys_cont$Timepoint <- factor(
  phys_cont$Timepoint,
  levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4")
)

phys_cont$ID <- factor(
  phys_cont$ID
)

dat_clean <- phys_cont[!is.na(phys_cont$SpO2), ]

m <- art(
  SpO2 ~ Session *Timepoint + (1|ID),
  data = dat_clean
)

anova(m)

art.con(
  m, ~ Session
)

art.con(
  m, ~ Timepoint
)

art.con(
  m, ~ Session*Timepoint
)

#FIGURE#

library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(dplyr)
library(ggnewscale)

## Colours
cols_raw <- c(
  "Sham"    = "#9EC5FE",
  "Hypoxia" = "#F6A3B4"
)

cols_mean <- c(
  "Sham"    = "#2D7FF9",
  "Hypoxia" = "#D7264C"
)

## Factors
dat_clean$Session <- factor(
  dat_clean$Session,
  levels = c("0","1"),
  labels = c("Sham","Hypoxia")
)

dat_clean$Timepoint <- factor(
  dat_clean$Timepoint,
  levels = c("1","2", "3", "4"),
  labels = c("Pre","0 min", "30 min", "60 min")
)

## Summary statistics
summary_df <-
  dat_clean %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, Session) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean  = mean(SpO2, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE    = sd(SpO2, na.rm = TRUE) /
              sqrt(sum(!is.na(SpO2))),
    Lower = Mean - 1.96 * SE,
    Upper = Mean + 1.96 * SE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p <- ggplot(dat_clean,
       aes(x = Timepoint,
           y = SpO2)) +

  ## Participant trajectories
  geom_line(
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Session)),
    colour = "grey75",
    alpha = .10,
    linewidth = .45
  ) +

  ## Raw observations
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(colour = Session),
    width = .10,
    size = 2.6,
    alpha = .55
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_raw) +

  ## Reset colour scale
  new_scale_colour() +

  ## Error bars (dark colours)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = Timepoint,
      y = Mean,
      ymin = Lower,
      ymax = Upper,
      colour = Session
    ),
    width = .1,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_mean) +

  ## Means
  geom_point(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = Timepoint,
      y = Mean,
      fill = Session
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    colour = "grey15",
    stroke = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_mean) +

  labs(
    x = expression(atop("Time (min)")),
    y = expression(atop("SpO2 (%)"))
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +

  theme(

    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title.y =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 18
      ),

    axis.text =
      element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 16
      ),

    strip.background =
      element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = NA
      ),

    strip.text =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 18
      ),

    panel.spacing =
      unit(1.3, "cm")
  )
```

PATH INTEGRATION TIME TO COMPLETE
```{r echo=FALSE}
library(ARTool)
library(dplyr)

dat$session <- factor(
  dat$session,
  levels = c("ses-0", "ses-1")
)

dat$intervention <- factor(
  dat$intervention,
  levels = c("continuous", "intermittent")
)

dat$subject <- factor(
  dat$subject
)

dat_clean <- dat[!is.na(dat$average_pi_total_time_change), ]


#ART ANOVA
m <- art(
  average_pi_total_time_change ~ intervention * session + (1|subject),
  data = dat_clean
)

anova(m)

#REGRESSION ON SPO2
hx_dat <- dat_clean %>%
  filter(session == "ses-1")

reg <- lm(
  average_pi_total_time_change ~ spo2 * intervention,
  data = hx_dat
)

summary(reg)
```

PATH INTEGRATION DISTANCE ERROR
```{r echo=FALSE}
library(ARTool)
library(dplyr)

dat$session <- factor(
  dat$session,
  levels = c("ses-0", "ses-1")
)

dat$intervention <- factor(
  dat$intervention,
  levels = c("continuous", "intermittent")
)

dat$subject <- factor(
  dat$subject)

dat_clean <- dat[!is.na(dat$average_pi_distance_change), ]

#ART ANOVA
m <- art(
  average_pi_distance_change ~ intervention * session + (1|subject),
  data = dat_clean
)

anova(m)

art.con(m, ~session)

#REGRESSION ON SPO2
hx_dat <- dat_clean %>%
  filter(session == "ses-1")

reg <- lm(
  average_pi_distance_change ~ spo2 * intervention,
  data = hx_dat
)

summary(reg)

#FIGURE#

library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggnewscale)

## Colours
cols_raw <- c(
  "Sham"    = "#9EC5FE",
  "Hypoxia" = "#F6A3B4"
)

cols_mean <- c(
  "Sham"    = "#2D7FF9",
  "Hypoxia" = "#D7264C"
)

## Factors
dat_clean$session <- factor(
  dat_clean$session,
  levels = c("ses-0","ses-1"),
  labels = c("Sham","Hypoxia")
)

dat_clean$intervention <- factor(
  dat_clean$intervention,
  levels = c("continuous","intermittent"),
  labels = c("ACH","AIH")
)

## Summary statistics
summary_df <-
  dat_clean %>%
  group_by(intervention, session) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean  = mean(average_pi_distance_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE    = sd(average_pi_distance_change, na.rm = TRUE) /
              sqrt(sum(!is.na(average_pi_distance_change))),
    Lower = Mean - 1.96 * SE,
    Upper = Mean + 1.96 * SE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p <- ggplot(dat_clean,
       aes(x = session,
           y = average_pi_distance_change)) +

  ## Participant trajectories
  geom_line(
    aes(group = subject),
    colour = "grey75",
    alpha = .10,
    linewidth = .45
  ) +

  ## Raw observations
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(colour = session),
    width = .10,
    size = 2.6,
    alpha = .55
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_raw) +

  ## Reset colour scale
  new_scale_colour() +

  ## Error bars (dark colours)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = session,
      y = Mean,
      ymin = Lower,
      ymax = Upper,
      colour = session
    ),
    width = .1,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_mean) +

  ## Means
  geom_point(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = session,
      y = Mean,
      fill = session
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    colour = "grey15",
    stroke = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_mean) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~intervention,
    nrow = 1
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(atop("Path integration distance",
                      "error (GU)"))
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +

  theme(

    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title.y =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 24
      ),

    axis.text =
      element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 20
      ),

    strip.background =
      element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = NA
      ),

    strip.text =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 24
      ),

    panel.spacing =
      unit(1.3, "cm")
  )
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
dat_clean <- dat[!is.na(dat$mapping_rsquare_change), ]

m <- art(
  mapping_rsquare_change ~ intervention * session + (1|subject),
  data = dat_clean
)

anova(m)

art.con(m, ~ session)
art.con(m, ~ intervention*session)

#REGRESSION ON SPO2
hx_dat <- dat_clean %>%
  filter(session == "ses-1")

reg <- lm(
  mapping_rsquare_change ~ spo2 * intervention,
  data = hx_dat
)

summary(reg)

emtrends(
  reg,
  ~ intervention,
  var = "spo2"
)

#FIGURE#

library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(dplyr)
library(ggnewscale)

## Colours
cols_raw <- c(
  "Sham"    = "#9EC5FE",
  "Hypoxia" = "#F6A3B4"
)

cols_mean <- c(
  "Sham"    = "#2D7FF9",
  "Hypoxia" = "#D7264C"
)

## Factors
dat_clean$session <- factor(
  dat_clean$session,
  levels = c("ses-0","ses-1"),
  labels = c("Sham","Hypoxia")
)

dat_clean$intervention <- factor(
  dat_clean$intervention,
  levels = c("continuous","intermittent"),
  labels = c("ACH","AIH")
)

## Summary statistics
summary_df <-
  dat_clean %>%
  group_by(intervention, session) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean  = mean(mapping_rsquare_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE    = sd(mapping_rsquare_change, na.rm = TRUE) /
              sqrt(sum(!is.na(mapping_rsquare_change))),
    Lower = Mean - 1.96 * SE,
    Upper = Mean + 1.96 * SE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p <- ggplot(dat_clean,
       aes(x = session,
           y = mapping_rsquare_change)) +

  ## Participant trajectories
  geom_line(
    aes(group = subject),
    colour = "grey75",
    alpha = .10,
    linewidth = .45
  ) +

  ## Raw observations
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(colour = session),
    width = .10,
    size = 2.6,
    alpha = .55
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_raw) +

  ## Reset colour scale
  new_scale_colour() +

  ## Error bars (dark colours)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = session,
      y = Mean,
      ymin = Lower,
      ymax = Upper,
      colour = session
    ),
    width = .1,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_mean) +

  ## Means
  geom_point(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = session,
      y = Mean,
      fill = session
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    colour = "grey15",
    stroke = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_mean) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~intervention,
    nrow = 1
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(atop("Mapping fit",
                        "("*R^2*")"))
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +

  theme(

    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title.y =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 24
      ),

    axis.text =
      element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 20
      ),

    strip.background =
      element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = NA
      ),

    strip.text =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 24
      ),

    panel.spacing =
      unit(1.3, "cm")
  )
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_raw) +

  ## Reset colour scale
  new_scale_colour() +

  ## Error bars (dark colours)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = session,
      y = Mean,
      ymin = Lower,
      ymax = Upper,
      colour = session
    ),
    width = .1,
    linewidth = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_mean) +

  ## Means
  geom_point(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = session,
      y = Mean,
      fill = session
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    colour = "black",
    stroke = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_mean) +

  facet_grid(
    eye_state ~ intervention,
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(atop("Beta power",
                      "(" * mu * "V)"))
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +

  theme(

    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title.y =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 18
      ),

    axis.text =
      element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 16
      ),

    strip.background =
      element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = NA
      ),

    strip.text =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 16
      ),

    panel.spacing =
      unit(1.3, "cm")
  )
```

BETA FREQUENCY
```{r echo=FALSE}
library(ARTool)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)

dat$session <- factor(
  dat$session,
  levels = c("ses-0", "ses-1")
)

dat$intervention <- factor(
  dat$intervention,
  levels = c("continuous", "intermittent")
)

dat$eye_state <- factor(
  dat$eye_state,
  levels = c("EC", "EO")
)

dat$subject <- factor(
  dat$subject)

dat_clean <- dat[!is.na(dat$beta_freq_mean_change), ]

m <- art(
  beta_freq_mean_change ~ intervention * session * eye_state + (1|subject),
  data = dat_clean
)

anova(m)
art.con(
  m, ~ intervention
)

art.con(
  m, ~ session
)

#REGRESSION ON SPO2
hx_dat <- dat_clean %>%
  filter(session == "ses-1")

reg <- lm(
  beta_freq_mean_change ~ spo2 * intervention,
  data = hx_dat
)

summary(reg)

#MAKE SUPPLEMENTARY TABLES
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(broom)


#reg table
reg_table <- tidy(reg) %>%
  mutate(
    p = case_when(
      p.value < .001 ~ "< .001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value)
    ),
    Estimate = sprintf("%.2f", estimate),
    SE = sprintf("%.2f", std.error),
    t = sprintf("%.2f", statistic)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Predictor = term,
    Estimate,
    SE,
    t,
    p
  )

kable(
  reg_table,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption = "Linear regression predicting change in beta central frequency\n from absolute SpO$_2$ and intervention.",
  escape = FALSE,
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "hold_position",
    font_size = 9,
    position = "left"
  )
```
